description: This Java class defines a REST controller named CustomerController for managing customer entities in a banking application. It provides endpoints for CRUD operations such as listing all customers, retrieving a customer by number, adding, updating, and deleting customers. The controller interacts with a BankingService component to perform the underlying business logic.

classes.name: CustomerController
classes.description: A REST controller managing customer data with CRUD API endpoints for a banking application.

methods.name: getCustomers
methods.description: Returns a list of all customers in JSON format.

methods.name: getAllCustomers
methods.description: Provides a legacy endpoint for listing all customers.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer entry based on provided CustomerDetails payload.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates existing customer data identified by customerNumber.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer record identified by customerNumber.
